plan.title: Scholarship Scheme Progress by District
plan.subtitle: Overview of application status and pending cases across districts

panels.title: Pending Cases
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending'

panels.title: Pending Percentage
panels.sql: SELECT (COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN "Status" != 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS pct FROM "scholarship_applicants"

panels.title: Applications by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS total_apps FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Pending Cases by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS pending_count FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Status" = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: District Status Breakdown
panels.sql: SELECT "District", "Status", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

plan.narrative:
The dashboard provides a comprehensive view of the scholarship scheme's progress, segmented by district. The total number of applications received is {{p1}}, serving as the baseline for all subsequent analysis.

A critical focus area is the number of pending cases, which currently stands at {{p2}}. This represents {{p3}} of the total applications, indicating the volume of work remaining before disbursement can be finalized.

When analyzing the distribution of applications across districts, {{p4}} shows the total volume per region. However, the operational bottleneck is best visualized in {{p5}}, which highlights the specific districts with the highest number of pending cases. For a granular view of how each district is performing across all statuses, refer to the detailed breakdown in {{p6}}.
